source.title: Changes in the Board of Directors (May 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

With the term of Board Members Blake Thompson and Nick Silvestri coming to an end, an anonymous election took place on May 1st, 2026. The election was conducted according to the WCA Motion: [Election of Directors](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2025.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf).

The Board received the applications of:

- Callum James Goodyear-Jørgensen
- Glib Vedmid
- Oliver Hexter
- Rubén López de Juan
- Sachin Arvind

We are happy to announce that Glib, Oliver, Rubén, and Sachin have been elected members of the WCA Board of Directors.

These changes have become effective immediately.

The applications can be viewed [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vhadNJj_uIkDkL-ZAD6kCrxxob3Rf1Fv).

translation.title: 董事会人员变动（2026 年 5 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

随着董事会成员 Blake Thompson 和 Nick Silvestri 的任期即将结束，WCA 于 2026 年 5 月 1 日举行了不记名选举。选举依照 WCA《[董事选举议案](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2025.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf)》进行。

董事会收到了以下人员的申请：

- Callum James Goodyear-Jørgensen
- Glib Vedmid
- Oliver Hexter
- Rubén López de Juan
- Sachin Arvind

我们很高兴宣布，Glib、Oliver、Rubén 和 Sachin 已当选为 WCA 董事会成员。

这些变动立即生效。

申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vhadNJj_uIkDkL-ZAD6kCrxxob3Rf1Fv)查看。
